design_detail: Regulatory erratum, not a study: a 9-page list, issued by the FDA for the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee meeting of 4 June 2024 on new drug application 215455 (midomafetamine capsules, Lykos Therapeutics, PTSD), of 29 corrections to the FDA briefing document (fda_2024a), each quoting the printed passage and the revised text, with additions in bold underline and deletions struck through. 24 corrections only restore table and figure numbers missing from cross-references; 5 change the content (items 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8). No issue date is printed. Card design 'narrative-review' is the schema's closest category for a regulatory notice; the editors' narrative-review checklist is used. No analyses of its own.
can_establish: Which passages of the FDA briefing document were corrected before the meeting and what the corrected text says.
cannot_establish: Why the passages were wrong, whether the committee saw the corrections before discussing them, or anything beyond the corrected wording.

sample.inclusion_exclusion: Not applicable; item 2 corrects the description of the trials' exclusion criteria (see key findings).

exposure.dose_frequency_duration_route: Not applicable; item 4 only restores the reference to the dosing table (Table 2) of the briefing document.

outcomes.instruments: Not applicable; item 3 corrects the description of the CAPS-5.
outcomes.multiplicity_correction: Not applicable; item 6 corrects the share of alpha spent on the sample-size re-estimation.

analysis.selective_reporting: None apparent: each correction quotes the printed text and the revision.

interpretation_gap.results_show: Five substantive corrections and 24 restored cross-references to the FDA briefing document.
interpretation_gap.claimed: The erratum claims nothing beyond the corrected wording.

timeline.event: FDA briefing document for the 4 June 2024 advisory committee meeting.
This erratum to it (date not printed; it speaks of the meeting in the future tense).
Advisory committee meeting of 4 June 2024 (final summary minutes).

replication.where_it_stands: The briefing document is cited on this site with these corrections applied (card sc_fda_2024a).

funding.funder: US Food and Drug Administration (government regulator).

what_would_settle_it: Nothing further is needed for the corrections themselves; for item 8, the MPLONG protocol or study report would show whether adverse events were reviewed at the follow-up visit.

domains.note: Not a review; it corrects one document, item by item.
Each correction quotes the original passage and the revision.

domains.domain: Reliance on the authors' own studies
domains.note: Concerns only the FDA's own briefing document, which is its subject.

domains.domain: Balance (not applicable to a list of corrections; nothing is argued)

risk_of_bias.reasoning: No validated instrument applies to an erratum (METHODS §5.3); the editors' narrative-review checklist is used as the closest available. The erratum is the primary record of the corrections and may be cited for them; it adds no data.

key_findings.finding: Item 2 (briefing document p. 19): the heading that restricted to MAPP2 the exclusion of people who had used ecstasy (material represented as containing MDMA) more than 10 times within the last 10 years or at least once within 6 months of the first medication session, or who had been in an earlier MAPS-sponsored MDMA trial, is deleted; the criterion is left without that restriction.
key_findings.locator: Item 2 (rendered page checked for the strikethrough)

key_findings.finding: Item 3 (briefing document p. 20): the CAPS-5 is a 30-item, not a 20-item, clinician-reported measure; the total severity score is the sum of the first 20 items, range 0 to 80.
Item 6 (briefing document p. 23): the sponsor allocated 0.2%, not 2%, of the alpha (0.0001) to the unblinded sample-size re-estimation.

Item 7 (briefing document p. 24): MPLONG enrolled participants who had received at least one dose of investigational medical product, drug or placebo (not of midomafetamine) in MAPP1, MAPP2, MP16 or MAPPUSX; the FDA's MPLONG analyses include only MAPP1 and MAPP2 participants.

Item 8 (briefing document p. 24): the MPLONG protocol included a review of medical history (the words adverse events are struck out), a single administration of the C-SSRS and a single administration of the parent study's primary efficacy measure.

Items 1, 4, 5 and 9 to 29 restore missing table and figure numbers in cross-references on pp. 17 to 82 of the briefing document (Tables 1 to 3, 5 to 10, 12 to 14 and 16 to 23; Figures 1 to 4); items 23 and 24 repeat the vital-sign figures unchanged (mean systolic rise 17 mm Hg, diastolic 7 mm Hg, heart rate 23 beats per minute after session 3; blood pressure of 140/90 mm Hg or more in 68% vs 22%, risk difference 45.6, 95% CI 33.1 to 58; systolic above 180 mm Hg in 6.1% vs 0.0%, risk difference 6.1, 1.4 to 10.8).

reporting_issues.issue: Item 7's revised text contains the misprint 'tfhis' for 'this'; item 2 leaves the following criterion (compensation litigation) in the list without saying whether it, too, applied to both trials.
reporting_issues.consequence: None for the claims; the litigation criterion's scope is not stated.

reporting_issues.issue: Item 24 keeps the briefing document's wording 'blood pressure at or above 140/90 mm Hg' for figures that Table 14 of the briefing gives for systolic pressure of 140 or more alone.
reporting_issues.consequence: Cite the rows of Table 14 (briefing document pp. 45-46) separately.

verification.source_read: PDF pp. 1-9 (PDFs/MDMA/FDA_2024_BriefingErrata.pdf), read in full from the text layer and every page rendered at 110 dpi to see which words are struck through or added (the text layer does not show the formatting).
